title: Ink in water
technique: A 2D fluid simulation in shaders, where words and model silhouettes are laid down as inks over paper.
music: Kicks fire jets that carry a drop of ink, snares spin up pairs of vortices, hi-hats add fine droplets and the bass slowly stirs the whole tank. The voice is a moving nozzle that squirts ink at a height that follows the sung pitch, and each new section of the song stamps a fresh shape in a new place.

takes.name: Phrase
takes.description: A poster phrase in glossy black ink sits off-centre in cream water, and each kick bursts as a red star of jets.
words: FLUID SIMULATION
INK IN WATER
KICKS FIRE JETS
SNARES SPIN VORTICES
BASS STIRS THE TANK
THE WORDS ARE INK IN A FLUID SIMULATION MADE OF SHADERS.
EACH KICK DRUM FIRES A RED STAR OF JETS INTO THE WATER.

takes.name: Marbling
takes.description: The whole frame is filled with red, yellow and blue bands, with no word at all, combed into marbled paper by jets from the edges.
words: THIS IS MARBLING: THREE INKS IN ONE SIMULATED FLUID.
EVERY KICK DRUM COMBS THE BANDS WITH A JET FROM THE EDGE.
WHERE TWO INKS OVERLAP, THE COLOUR GOES DARKER.

takes.name: Night
takes.description: A single 3D model appears as glowing ivory ink in dark navy water, with pink jets from the frame edges and yellow snares.
words: A 3D MODEL IS POURED INTO A FLUID SIMULATION AS GLOWING INK.
KICKS ARE PINK JETS. SNARES ARE YELLOW VORTEX PAIRS.

takes.name: Inkblot
takes.description: Half the tank is mirrored down the middle like a folded inkblot test plate, with black blots and one red on white card above a typed caption.
words: THIS IS HALF A TANK OF SIMULATED INK, MIRRORED DOWN THE FOLD.
DRUM HITS DROP INK ON THE LEFT. THE RIGHT IS A REFLECTION.
KICKS ARE BLACK STARS. SNARES ARE RED VORTEX PAIRS.

takes.name: Bleeding page
takes.description: A full page of small print bleeds away in pure black and white dots, sometimes inverted to white on black, and is printed again on every bar line.
words: THIS PAGE IS INK IN A SIMULATED TANK OF WATER.
THE WATER IS A GRID OF 320 X 180 ARROWS THAT SAY
HOW FAST IT MOVES AT EACH POINT.
EVERY FRAME THE ARROWS CARRY THEMSELVES ALONG,
THEN A SOLVER RUNS 22 PASSES SO THAT WATER
NEVER PILES UP ANYWHERE.
THE INK IS A 1280 X 720 PICTURE THAT THE
ARROWS DRAG ALONG.
A KICK DRUM FIRES A STAR OF JETS AND A DROP OF INK.
A SNARE SPINS TWO VORTICES IN OPPOSITE WAYS.
A HI-HAT ADDS ONE FINE DROPLET.
THE BASS SLOWLY STIRS THE WHOLE TANK.
THE VOICE IS A NOZZLE: A HIGHER NOTE SITS HIGHER UP.
EVERY BAR OF THE SONG PRINTS THIS PAGE AGAIN.
THE PICTURE IS ONLY BLACK AND WHITE DOTS.
NOTHING HERE IS VIDEO. NINE SHADERS RUN EVERY FRAME.

takes.name: Oil film
takes.description: A phrase larger than the frame floats as an oil film on black water, so its colour comes from the thickness of the film and shifts in rings as it thins.
words: OIL FILM
COLOUR IS THICKNESS
THIN FILM
INK IN WATER
THIS IS AN OIL FILM: ITS COLOUR COMES FROM HOW THICK IT IS.
THE LETTERS CHANGE COLOUR AS THE FLUID STRETCHES THEM.

takes.name: Sinking
takes.description: Seen from the side, a row of three small model silhouettes at the top sinks as plumes while kicks fall as red drops from above.
words: THIS IS A SIDE VIEW: THE INK IS HEAVIER THAN WATER AND SINKS.
EACH KICK DRUM IS A RED DROP FALLING FROM THE TOP.

takes.name: Survey
takes.description: One model is drawn only as contour lines of ink thickness on green graph paper, with no gloss and barely any fill.
words: THE SAME FLUID IS DRAWN AS A MAP OF INK THICKNESS.
EVERY LINE JOINS POINTS HOLDING THE SAME AMOUNT OF INK.

takes.name: Macro
takes.description: Letters three times the height of the frame leave only fragments in view, in thick red, yellow and blue inks that mix under a strongly rippled surface.
words: FLUID
INK
FLOW
VORTEX
JET
UP CLOSE, THE THREE INKS MIX LIKE COLOURED FILTERS.
THE GLOSS IS LIGHT ON THE SLOPES OF THE THICK INK.

takes.name: Sheet
takes.description: A printed star chart lies under the water and bends with every ripple, with a small red stamped phrase on it, black kick stars and blue ink from the voice.
words: SIMULATED INK
FLUID SOLVER
INK IN WATER
INK IN WATER
TECHNIQUE:  2D FLUID SIMULATION
WATER:  320 X 180 VELOCITY GRID
INK:  1280 X 720, THREE INKS
SOLVER:  22 PASSES A FRAME
KICK:  JETS + INK
SNARE:  TWO VORTICES
HI-HAT:  A DROPLET
BASS:  STIRS THE TANK
VOICE:  A NOZZLE
THE SHEET LIES UNDER SIMULATED WATER, AND RIPPLES BEND IT.

as_processor: It turns the picture into ink in a fluid simulation: bright or dark shapes are pressed into the water on every beat and the drums tear them apart, while the Sheet take instead lays the picture under rippling water.
